["SELECT (MAX(e.value_num) - MIN(e.value_num)) AS total_revision, COUNT(e.evidence_id) AS revision_count
FROM (
  SELECT e.evidence_id, f.value_num
  FROM facts f
  JOIN evidence e ON f.evidence_id = e.evidence_id
  WHERE f.subject = 'US_PAYROLLS | US nonfarm payroll employment' AND f.attribute = 'estimate'

) AS e;"]

  FROM facts
  WHERE subject = 'AAPL | Revenues' AND attribute = 'value_usd_m'
  ORDER BY learned_at DESC

  SELECT period, value_num, effective_at, learned_at, kind, evidence_id
  FROM facts
  WHERE subject = 'AAPL | Revenues' AND attribute = 'value_usd_m'

  LIMIT 1

  SELECT period, value_num, effective_at, learned_at, kind, evidence_id

question: What was the year-over-year revenue growth (percent) of PROCTER & GAMBLE Co's most recently reported fiscal quarter (three-month figures)?

FROM (
  SELECT period, value_num, effective_at, learned_at, kind,
  LAG(value_num) OVER (ORDER BY learned_at DESC) AS prev_value_num, evidence_id
  FROM facts
  WHERE subject = 'PG | Revenues' AND attribute = 'value_usd_m' AND kind = 'new'
) AS new
JOIN facts AS corroborate
ON new.evidence_id = corroborate.evidence_id
AND corroborate.kind = 'corroborate'
AND corroborate.period = (
  CASE
    WHEN new.period LIKE '%-07-01..%-%-03-31' THEN new.period
    WHEN new.period LIKE '%-10-01..%-%-12-31' THEN new.period
    ELSE NULL
  END
)
ORDER BY corroborate.learned_at DESC
LIMIT 1;"]

  LIMIT 1

    SELECT value_num, period FROM facts
    WHERE subject = 'UNH | Revenues' AND attribute = 'value_usd_m' AND kind = 'corroborate'
  ORDER BY learned_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
) AS previous", "SELECT (latest.value_num - previous.value_num) / previous.value_num * 100 AS yoy_growth_percent, latest.period, 'new' AS kind
FROM facts
